value.rationale: A natural exact spectral invariant for compact differences is evaluated, including a sharp boundary blowup and a positive reduced-degree arithmetic overlap which is undetectable from the Hilbert–Schmidt trace. The coefficient has a useful parameter law and weight-independent normalized collision factor for every admissible degree/rate. This goes beyond membership criteria and provides a structural quantitative baseline for multi-symbol composition problems.
